CONTRACT CHALLENGE — Build V2 Knowledge System + Choice Architecture — 4-moment capture, 4-layer detection, dual-mode delivery, multi-pressure selection

Acceptance criteria: 4-moment capture model implemented (before/during/after work + across compaction); 4-layer detection pipeline: L0 file type, L1 tool sequences, L2 reasoning-trace TF-IDF, L3 peer awareness; Dual delivery: blocking nudges (rare, 1-2/session) + contextual injection (frequent, zero-friction); Multi-pressure selection: Joel grading + outcome validation + behavioral echoes + temporal decay; Triangulation rule: blocking nudge only when 2+ layers agree; Research items 1-3 validated with data before full build

Silhouette: PRD Block 4+10 (merged). EXTERNALLY VALIDATED: 2 rounds jailbreak + horsepower, 3 external models, 4 internal agents, 44 entries. Architecture survived challenge. Gemini killed sole keyword detection → 4-layer pipeline. DeepSeek saved hybrid signatures. 8d5e70ef proved dual-mode delivery from V1 operational data. Research agenda has 7 items ordered by buildability.

This contract requires external challenge. Requesting perspective.
